name: Bulk WooCommerce Category Creator
author: kartikparmar

sections.description:
This plugin allows WooCommerce store owners to create WooCommerce categories in bulk. You just have to enter categories separated by commas, the parent category in which you want to add all those categories, a description if any and the display type.

You can also create categories in Parent-Child hierarchy by using >> between levels. e.g Parent A>>Child A

Also, at the time of creating categories you can assign them to selected products.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Go to Products > Bulk Category Creator.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send data anywhere?

No. It does not connect to any external service and does not collect or transmit any data.

Who can use it?

Users who can manage product categories (Administrators and Shop Managers). Categories are only assigned to products the user is allowed to edit.
sections.changelog:
2.5

  • New: Choose the separators between categories and between parent and child.
  • New: Live preview of the categories before creating them.
  • New: Categories can be entered one per line.
  • New: Pro features shown as tabs on the plugin page.
  • Fix: “All Products” now runs in the background, so large stores no longer time out.
  • Fix: Product search loads products as you type instead of all at once.
  • Fix: Blank entries and blank hierarchy levels are skipped with a notice.
  • Fix: Form values are kept when nothing could be created.
  • Tweak: Switches itself off when the Pro version is active.

2.4

  • Security: Removed the Freemius SDK. The plugin no longer contacts any external service.
  • Security: Added nonce and capability checks to the category creation form.
  • Security: All input is now unslashed and sanitized; parent and display type are validated.
  • Security: Category assignment is limited to products the user can edit.
  • Fix: Category names containing apostrophes were saved with a backslash.
  • Fix: Existing categories were checked against the wrong taxonomy.
  • Fix: Review notice never appeared; it is now dismissible with a nonce and only shown on the plugin page.
  • Tweak: Scripts load only on the plugin page and use WooCommerce’s bundled selectWoo.
  • Tweak: Text domain now matches the plugin slug.
  • Tweak: Declared WooCommerce HPOS compatibility. Added uninstall cleanup.
  • Tweak: Requires PHP 7.4 and WordPress 5.8.

2.3 (30.4.2022)

  • Updated Freemius SDK

2.2 (28.1.2022)

  • Compatibility with v5.9 WordPress and v6.0 WooCommerce
  • Filter – Added bwcc_separator filter to change the comma separator.

2.1 (21.8.2021)

  • Tweak – Allow adding categories with same name in different parent category.
